prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized orca seen from the side, body in profile, centered and
filling the icon area. Simplified app-icon geometry. The body is a
confident flat saturated palette color (deep navy or black). A single
small WHITE oval near the head indicates the eye-patch. The dorsal fin
on top and the tail fluke at the back are clearly visible as simple
geometric shapes — NOT separate floating pieces, but a single
continuous silhouette. No water, no scene, no frame.
formatted_prompt:
STYLE: flat vector app icon; bold filled silhouette with crisp geometric edges; single unified continuous shape; modern UI icon register — SF Symbols Filled aesthetic; centered on plain off-white canvas with generous padding; zero texture, zero brushwork, zero gradients

SUBJECT: adult orca in strict side profile; one continuous unified silhouette — torpedo body, upright triangular dorsal fin rising from the back, sweeping tail fluke at the rear, all locked into a single bold geometric shape; body filled in flat #000000 black; one small flat #FFFFFF white oval placed near the head to indicate the eye-patch marking; narrow pointed rostrum, lean adult proportions, no cartoon inflation

CONTEXT: isolated app icon, no water, no scene, no environmental elements, no frame; subject centered with generous padding on all sides against a plain off-white canvas

COLOR: #000000 flat fill for the entire orca body silhouette; #FFFFFF flat fill for the single small eye-patch oval near the head; off-white plain canvas background

DETAILS: every edge crisp and deliberate vector geometry; dorsal fin and tail fluke read as clear distinct shapes within the unified silhouette; full readability at 16px; interior eye-patch oval is the sole secondary shape; no outlines, no strokes, no shadows, no depth shading

CONSTRAINTS: single continuous silhouette only — no floating parts, no separated fin pieces; flat fills exclusively; no gradients, no textures, no ink marks, no watercolor, no aging
